title: prop:decomp: placeholder EW24 citation and invariant-measure uniqueness make 'fixed-time law = mu' not self-contained

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Proposition `prop:decomp`, Step (2)(β) ("fixed-time law $=\mu$" via uniqueness
of the invariant measure), and the bibliography entry `EW24`.

**Gap (MINOR, citation/self-containedness).** Two items needed to make the decomposition of
$\mu$ rigorous are only gestured at:

1. **Placeholder citation.** The reference `\bibitem{EW24} W. E. / et al.; see also
   stationary $\Phi^4_3$ constructions.` is not a real citation. Yet `EW24` is invoked
   repeatedly for the *existence and stationarity* of the full-line stationary solution
   (Step (1)), the *time-continuity* of all five fields $\mathbf l,\mathbf q,\mathbf C,v,v^\sharp$
   in their Hölder–Besov spaces (Step (3), needed to evaluate the paracontrolled identity at
   the single time $t=0$), and "construct the stationary solution started from $\mu$ at
   $-\infty$". These are load-bearing facts and require a precise reference (e.g.
   Gubinelli–Hofmanová, or Albeverio–Kusuoka for the measure, or the relevant stationary
   $\Phi^4_3$ construction).

2. **Uniqueness of the invariant measure.** Step (2)(β) deduces "fixed-time law of the
   stationary solution $=\mu$" from the assertion that $\mu$ is the *unique* invariant
   probability measure, citing strong Feller + irreducibility (HM18). The uniqueness of the
   invariant measure for the $\Phi^4_3$ dynamics on the relevant state space should be cited
   at the level of a specific theorem, or the alternative route (construct the stationary
   solution from $\mu$ at $t=-\infty$, so its time-$t$ law is $\mu$ by invariance) made the
   primary argument so that uniqueness is not needed.

This is not deep, but the present proof of Proposition `prop:decomp`(a) — the statement
$\mathrm{Law}(u(0,\cdot))=\mu$ on which the entire singularity argument rests — is not
self-contained without it. (Note: issue q1-7 covering "identification of fixed-time law with
$\mu$ and descent" is marked *resolved*, but the placeholder `EW24` citation and the
explicit invariant-measure-uniqueness reference remain unaddressed in the current
`solution.tex`.)
